description: Source file for OTPValidationScreen widget in a Flutter app. Implements phone number entry, social sign-in buttons, and navigation logic for OTP validation.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the OTP validation screen, including header, social buttons, phone input, Continue button, and test skip button.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap on Continue button, detecting triple taps for testing bypass or proceeding with phone verification.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: Test method to simulate login bypass, update preferences, and navigate to home activity.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Validates phone number input and navigates to OTPSecondScreen if valid.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Mocks Google sign-in by updating preferences and navigating to HomeActivity.
